about_zh: 路线图、教程、书籍、算法与科研。

repos.description: :books: 技术面试必备基础知识、Leetcode、计算机操作系统、计算机网络、系统设计
repos.summary_zh: CS-Notes 是面向技术面试的综合性学习资源，涵盖算法、操作系统、计算机网络、数据库、Java 核心技术及系统设计等计算机基础核心领域。内容结构清晰，包含剑指 Offer 和 Leetcode 题解，适合系统复习与刷题备考。
repos.summary_en: CS-Notes is a comprehensive study resource for technical interviews, covering core computer science topics including algorithms, operating systems, computer networks, databases, Java fundamentals, and system design. It features structured content with solutions to 'Jianzhi Offer' and Leetcode problems, ideal for systematic review and coding practice.

repos.description: Java 面试 & 后端通用面试指南，覆盖计算机基础、数据库、分布式、高并发与系统设计。准备后端技术面试，首选 JavaGuide！
repos.summary_zh: JavaGuide 是 Java 及后端技术面试的权威指南，涵盖 Java 基础、集合、并发、IO、JVM、数据库、分布式、高并发与系统设计等核心知识。提供系统化面试题解析、源码深度剖析及实战项目（如 AI 智能面试平台），支持在线阅读与 PDF 下载，是后端开发者备战大厂面试的首选资源。
repos.summary_en: JavaGuide is the authoritative guide for Java and backend technical interviews, covering core topics including Java fundamentals, collections, concurrency, I/O, JVM, databases, distributed systems, high-concurrency, and system design. It offers systematic interview question analysis, in-depth source code breakdowns, and practical projects (e.g., AI-powered interview assistant), with online reading and PDF download options. It's the top resource for backend developers preparing for top-tier tech interviews.

repos.description: 《动手学深度学习》：面向中文读者、能运行、可讨论。中英文版被70多个国家的500多所大学用于教学。
repos.summary_zh: 《动手学深度学习》是一本面向中文读者的开源深度学习教材，提供可运行代码与交互式学习体验，覆盖数学原理、算法实现与工程实践。该书被全球500多所大学采用，支持中英双语教学，强调批判性思维与动手能力，助力学习者成为具备实战能力的AI应用科学家。
repos.summary_en: Dive into Deep Learning is an open-source textbook designed for Chinese readers, offering executable code and interactive learning. It integrates mathematical theory, algorithmic implementation, and engineering practice, adopted by over 500 universities worldwide. The book emphasizes hands-on learning to cultivate AI application scientists with both theoretical depth and practical skills.

repos.description: An advanced guide which might benefit you a lot 🎉 . 人生进阶指南 离谱的人生 离谱的英语学习指南/英语学习教程/英语学习/学英语
repos.summary_zh: 《离谱的英语学习指南》是一份系统化的英语进阶学习指南，结合作者自身高分经验与科学方法，涵盖词汇、听力、阅读、口语、写作及AI辅助等模块，强调语言学习的自然性与趣味性，提供从CEFR等级到实用技巧的完整路径，助力学习者高效突破瓶颈。
repos.summary_en: This advanced English learning guide offers a comprehensive, scientifically-informed approach to mastering English through structured modules on vocabulary, listening, reading, speaking, writing, and AI tools. It emphasizes natural language acquisition and personal enjoyment, providing a clear roadmap from CEFR levels to practical strategies for learners aiming to break through plateaus.

repos.description: :fireworks:Interactive Online Platform that Visualizes Algorithms from Code
repos.summary_zh: Algorithm Visualizer 是一个交互式在线平台，通过可视化代码将算法动态呈现，帮助学习者和开发者直观理解算法执行过程。支持多种编程语言，提供丰富的教程与可视化效果，适用于教学与算法研究。
repos.summary_en: Algorithm Visualizer is an interactive online platform that brings algorithms to life through code visualization. It supports multiple programming languages and offers engaging educational content, making algorithm learning intuitive and effective for students and professionals.

repos.description: 程序员如何优雅的挣零花钱，2.0版，升级为小书了。Most of this not work outside China , so no English translate
repos.summary_zh: 《程序员如何优雅的挣零花钱？》是一本专为程序员设计的副业指南，聚焦中国市场的变现策略，涵盖知识付费、网课制作、内容创作等路径，结合《一人企业方法论2.0》与《全栈路线图》资源，提供实战思维导图与电子书下载，助力技术人实现可持续的被动收入。
repos.summary_en: This repo offers a practical guide for programmers to earn side income in China, covering monetization strategies like online courses, content creation, and knowledge products. It integrates resources from 'One-Person Business Methodology 2.0' and 'Full-Stack Roadmap', providing downloadable mind maps and eBooks to help tech professionals build passive income streams.

repos.description: 关于Python的面试题
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库系统整理了Python语言特性、操作系统、数据库、网络及数据结构等核心面试知识点，涵盖函数参数传递、元类、装饰器、GIL、协程、垃圾回收机制等高级特性，并提供经典编程题解析（如斐波那契、链表操作、排序算法），是Python开发者面试准备的权威资料库。
repos.summary_en: This repository compiles comprehensive Python interview questions covering language features (e.g., metaclasses, decorators, GIL), operating systems (IPC, memory management), databases (transactions, MVCC), networking (TCP/IP, HTTP), and data structures. It includes algorithm implementations like Fibonacci, sorting, and tree traversals, serving as a complete technical reference for Python job interviews.

repos.description: 经典编程书籍大全，涵盖：计算机系统与网络、系统架构、算法与数据结构、前端开发、后端开发、移动开发、数据库、测试、项目与团队、程序员职业修炼、求职面试等
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库收录100+经典编程书籍，全面覆盖计算机系统与网络、算法与数据结构、前后端开发、数据库、测试、职业修炼等核心领域，精选伯乐在线及社区广泛推荐的权威技术读物，是程序员系统提升技能的理想资源库。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates 100+ essential programming books across core domains including computer systems, algorithms, web/mobile development, databases, testing, and career growth. It aggregates highly recommended technical reads from Jobbole and the developer community, serving as a comprehensive learning resource for programmers.

repos.description: Dopamine is a research framework for fast prototyping of reinforcement learning algorithms.
repos.summary_zh: Dopamine 是谷歌开发的强化学习研究框架，专为快速原型设计和算法实验而设计。它支持 DQN、Rainbow、SAC 等主流算法，基于 JAX 实现，强调易实验性、灵活开发和可复现性，适用于学术研究和算法验证。
repos.summary_en: Dopamine is a research framework by Google for rapid prototyping of reinforcement learning algorithms. It supports DQN, Rainbow, SAC, and other state-of-the-art agents, implemented in JAX, with a focus on ease of experimentation, flexibility, and reproducibility for speculative research.

repos.description: 🐸 Read Frog - Open-source AI language learning & flashcards, an Immersive Translate alternative | 🐸 陪读蛙 - 开源 AI 语言学习与闪词卡，沉浸式翻译替代
repos.summary_zh: Read Frog 是一款开源浏览器 AI 语言学习扩展，支持沉浸式翻译、文章分析、多 AI 模型适配及字幕翻译。提供双语对照、上下文感知翻译、自定义提示词、批量请求和文本转语音功能，覆盖 Chrome/Edge/Firefox，助力用户高效深度学习。
repos.summary_en: Read Frog is an open-source browser extension for AI-powered language learning, offering immersive translation, article analysis, subtitle translation, and TTS. It supports bilingual mode, context-aware translation, custom prompts, batch requests, and integrates 20+ AI providers across Chrome, Edge, and Firefox.

repos.description: iOS interview questions;iOS面试题集锦（附答案）
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库系统整理了iOS开发面试中的核心知识点，涵盖Objective-C和Swift两大技术栈，包含55道经典面试题及详细参考答案，重点涉及内存管理、多线程、Runtime机制、KVC/KVO、Block等底层原理，并提供理论篇与实践篇双版本解析，是iOS开发者求职与技能提升的权威参考资料。
repos.summary_en: This repository compiles 55 essential iOS interview questions with comprehensive answers in both Objective-C and Swift, covering core topics like memory management, multithreading, Runtime mechanisms, KVC/KVO, and Blocks. It includes theoretical and practical sections, serving as a definitive resource for iOS developers preparing for technical interviews and deepening their understanding of system-level concepts.

repos.description: :100: 2026年系统架构设计师（软考高级）备考资料。
repos.summary_zh: 该项目为2026年软考高级系统架构设计师备考资料库，涵盖历年真题、模拟卷、精讲视频及论文范文，支持免费与付费资源更新。提供多平台刷题工具（网页/小程序/App），并持续优化教程与考纲解析，助力考生高效通过考试。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides comprehensive study materials for the 2026 System Architect Designer exam (a senior-level soft certification). It includes past papers, mock tests, video courses, and essay templates. Free and paid resources are updated regularly, with multi-platform practice tools (web, WeChat mini-program, mobile app) and optimized tutorials to help candidates pass efficiently.

repos.description: Python 黑魔法手册
repos.summary_zh: 《Python 黑魔法手册》是一本深入解析 Python 语言隐藏特性与进阶技巧的电子书，涵盖冷门语法、Shell 高级用法、代码炫技及底层机制解读，旨在帮助开发者突破常规认知，掌握高效、优雅的 Python 编程范式。
repos.summary_en: The 'Magic Python' handbook is an eBook exploring advanced and lesser-known Python features, including obscure syntax, shell tricks, code hacks, and deep technical insights, designed to help developers master elegant and efficient Python programming beyond basic tutorials.

repos.description: 浸入式学语言助手 (Immersive Language Learning Assistant)
repos.summary_zh: 浸入式语言学习助手是一款基于‘可理解输入’理论的浏览器插件，通过智能翻译网页词汇并集成发音功能，实现自然语言习得。支持自动语言检测、AI选词、双语音频朗读及交互式提示，将整个互联网转化为个性化学习材料。
repos.summary_en: An immersive language learning browser extension based on 'comprehensible input' theory, intelligently translating selected words with pronunciation support. Features automatic language detection, AI-driven vocabulary selection, dual TTS, and interactive tooltips to turn the web into personalized learning content.

repos.description: Browser-based media player and Chrome extension for subtitle sentence mining
repos.summary_zh: asbplayer 是一款基于浏览器的媒体播放器及 Chrome 扩展，专为通过字幕视频学习语言的用户设计。它支持将字幕加载到主流流媒体平台（如 YouTube、Netflix），并提供字幕导航、多播放模式（快进/跳过无字幕片段）、自动暂停等功能，帮助用户高效创建多媒体闪卡并优化语言学习体验。
repos.summary_en: asbplayer is a browser-based media player and Chrome extension tailored for language learners using subtitled content. It enables loading selectable subtitles from streaming platforms like YouTube and Netflix, supports subtitle navigation, playback modes (e.g., condensed/fast-forward), and integrates with tools like Yomitan for word styling and annotation to enhance vocabulary acquisition.

repos.description: :books:Java核心知识点整理（包括Java基础、JVM、数据库、计算机网络、算法、操作系统、设计模式、系统设计、框架原理）
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库系统整理 Java 核心技术知识体系，涵盖 Java 基础、JVM、并发编程、容器类、数据库（MySQL、Redis）、计算机网络、算法（数据结构、LeetCode、海量数据处理）、操作系统（Linux）、设计模式及主流框架原理（Spring、MyBatis、Dubbo、Netty、Kafka、Zookeeper、Nginx、Tomcat）。内容结构清晰，适合 Java 开发者系统学习与面试准备。
repos.summary_en: This repository systematically organizes core Java knowledge, covering Java fundamentals, JVM, concurrency, collections, databases (MySQL, Redis), computer networks, algorithms (data structures, LeetCode, big data), operating systems (Linux), design patterns, and framework principles (Spring, MyBatis, Dubbo, Netty, Kafka, Zookeeper, Nginx, Tomcat). It provides structured learning materials ideal for Java developers and interview preparation.

repos.description: 如果有人让你推荐 Python 技术书，请让他看这个列表
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为 Python 开发者精心整理的权威技术书籍推荐列表，涵盖入门到进阶全阶段，包含《Head First Python》《集体智慧编程》《利用 Python 进行数据分析》等经典著作，结合社区投票与豆瓣评分，提供高质量学习资源导航。
repos.summary_en: This repo curates a comprehensive list of authoritative Python technical books from beginner to advanced levels, featuring classics like 'Head First Python', 'Programming Collective Intelligence', and 'Python for Data Analysis', backed by community votes and Douban ratings for reliable learning guidance.

repos.description: Browser-based media player and Chrome extension for subtitle sentence mining
repos.summary_zh: asbplayer 是一款基于浏览器的媒体播放器及 Chrome 扩展，专为通过字幕视频学习语言的用户设计。支持将字幕加载到主流流媒体平台（如 YouTube、Netflix），提供可导航的字幕列表、多种播放模式（如跳过无字幕片段、自动暂停）以及高质量多媒体闪卡生成功能，显著提升语言学习效率。
repos.summary_en: asbplayer is a browser-based media player and Chrome extension tailored for language learners using subtitled videos. It enables loading selectable subtitles onto streaming platforms like YouTube and Netflix, supports navigable subtitle lists, condensed playback modes, and multimedia flashcard creation to optimize vocabulary acquisition.

repos.description: 智能助教系统，利用大模型根据课程相关文档自动生成题目并且批改
repos.summary_zh: CogniLoop 是一个基于大模型的智能助教系统，支持根据课程文档自动生成个性化试题并自动批改。系统构建去中心化学习社区，提供知识库创建、自适应出题、学习圈子及挑战赛功能，通过用户学习轨迹优化策略，实现千人千面的AI驱动教育辅助工具。
repos.summary_en: CogniLoop is an AI-powered intelligent tutoring system that generates and grades personalized questions from course documents. It builds a decentralized learning community with knowledge bases, adaptive quizzes, study groups, and challenges, continuously optimizing question strategies based on individual learning paths for truly personalized education.

repos.description: 智能替换网页词汇，创造沉浸式双语学习环境，在日常浏览中自然习得语言。
repos.summary_zh: VocabMeld 是一款 Chrome 插件，基于可理解性输入理论，通过智能替换网页词汇为母语翻译，创造沉浸式双语学习环境。支持多 LLM 服务（DeepSeek、OpenAI 等），CEFR 难度分级，LRU 缓存加速，本地存储保障隐私，提供强度与样式自定义选项，让语言学习自然融入日常浏览。
repos.summary_en: VocabMeld is a Chrome extension that creates an immersive bilingual learning environment by intelligently replacing webpage vocabulary with translations. Built on the 'comprehensible input' theory, it supports multiple LLMs (DeepSeek, OpenAI, etc.), CEFR-level filtering, LRU caching for speed, local storage for privacy, and customizable intensity/styles for natural language acquisition during daily browsing.

repos.description: AI-enhanced reading tool for immersive language learning using the n+1 method. Learn languages by staying in the target language ecosystem, with a flow-state focused interface.
repos.summary_zh: ReadBridge 是一款基于 AI 的沉浸式语言学习工具，采用 n+1 可理解输入法，帮助学习者在目标语言生态中通过阅读进行自然习得。其核心优势在于减少母语翻译依赖，提供句子级交互阅读、AI 目标语言解释、自定义难度设置及进度追踪，支持网页与跨平台桌面端（Tauri）。
repos.summary_en: ReadBridge is an AI-enhanced reading tool for immersive language learning using the n+1 comprehensible input method. It enables learners to acquire languages naturally by reading within the target language ecosystem, featuring sentence-by-sentence interaction, AI-powered target-language explanations, customizable difficulty prompts, and progress tracking across web and desktop (via Tauri).

repos.description: ChatGPT&AIGC资料汇总，包含前沿资讯、应用案例、技术教程、开源项目和商业变现等
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为ChatGPT与AIGC领域的综合性资料库，涵盖前沿资讯、应用案例、技术教程、开源项目与商业变现路径，提供注册升级指南及深度行业研报，助力开发者与从业者快速掌握AI技术生态与落地场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository aggregates comprehensive resources on ChatGPT and AIGC, including cutting-edge news, application cases, technical tutorials, open-source projects, and monetization strategies. It provides registration/guide tutorials and in-depth industry reports to help developers and professionals quickly master the AI technology ecosystem and real-world applications.

repos.description: 各类资源软件所需的接口，一些资源接口，接口收集    已有：TVBox接口 Legado阅读3.x书源
repos.summary_zh: CandyMuj/ResourceInterface 是一个提供各类资源软件接口的仓库，目前包含 TVBox 接口和 Legado 阅读3.x 书源。支持自定义敏感配置，提供主域名及多平台备用访问地址，解决部分地区访问限制问题。项目长期维护，含捐赠与防失联机制，适用于影视、阅读等场景。
repos.summary_en: CandyMuj/ResourceInterface provides resource interfaces for various software, including TVBox APIs and Legado 3.x book sources. It supports custom sensitive configurations and offers multiple access addresses with CDN acceleration to bypass regional restrictions. The project is actively maintained with donation support and community channels.

repos.description: Parallel Programming with Python简体中文版
repos.summary_zh: 《Parallel Programming with Python》简体中文版是一本系统讲解Python并行编程的书籍，涵盖并发、并行与分布式编程的核心概念、算法设计与实践工具。内容从GIL限制、通信机制到分治、数据分解、管道任务等并行模式，结合斐波那契计算与网页爬取等实例，帮助开发者识别可并行问题并高效实现多核/分布式加速。
repos.summary_en: The Chinese translation of 'Parallel Programming with Python' is a comprehensive guide covering core concepts, algorithms, and tools for concurrent, parallel, and distributed programming in Python. It addresses GIL limitations, communication patterns, and parallel design techniques like divide-and-conquer and data decomposition, with practical examples such as Fibonacci computation and web scraping to demonstrate parallelizable problems and multi-core/distributed acceleration.

repos.description: 麻将AI算法（包含全概率估算、局部概率估算、深度学习版本）
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库实现多种麻将AI算法，包括基于KNN的全局与局部概率估算、深度学习版本。核心功能涵盖听牌匹配、胡牌概率计算及最优出牌决策，支持万筒条三色14张牌判断，C语言单线程性能达6秒，Lua版约900秒，具备跨平台扩展潜力。
repos.summary_en: This repository implements multiple Mahjong AI algorithms, including full and local probability estimation via KNN and deep learning. Key features include tile matching for winning hands, probability calculation for optimal discards, and decision-making support for 14-tile games (Mentsu, Pinzu, Souzu). C version processes in 6 seconds (single-thread), Lua in 900s, with plans to optimize via color-based segmentation.

repos.description: Lingkuma - An open-source alternative to LingQ for learning any language on the web
repos.summary_zh: LingKuma 是一款跨平台的网页语言学习工具，支持 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 浏览器扩展及 iOS/Android 移动端。核心功能包括智能高亮翻译、AI 句子解析、生词笔记、TTS 语音朗读等，兼容 EPUB 阅读器和 PDF 文档，提供 WebDAV/Docker 数据同步，助力沉浸式语言学习。
repos.summary_en: LingKuma is a cross-platform web language learning tool with browser extensions (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) and mobile apps (iOS/Android). It features AI-powered translation, word highlighting, sentence analysis, TTS voice synthesis, and supports EPUB/PDF reading. Offers seamless sync via WebDAV or Docker for personalized, immersive language acquisition.

repos.description: One has no future if one couldn't teach themself.
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是《自学是一门手艺》的配套代码与学习资源，旨在帮助开发者掌握自主学习的方法论。通过结构化练习和项目实践，引导读者从被动接受知识转向主动构建知识体系，适用于编程初学者及终身学习者提升自我教育能力。
repos.summary_en: This repository accompanies 'The Craft of Self-Teaching', providing code examples and learning resources to master self-directed learning. It guides users from passive knowledge absorption to active construction of personal knowledge systems through structured exercises, ideal for programming beginners and lifelong learners.
